reasons.persona_fit: Precisely addresses the small-business owner-operator in Bareni's calm, technical, yet plain voice without hype, adhering strictly to the no-CTA brief.
reasons.clarity: Immediately establishes a logical distinction between rollback and real-time control, with clear examples and well-structured progression.
reasons.actionability: Provides an achievable, bounded method for the owner: identify top failure modes and place a human approval gate before actions are committed.
reasons.factual_grounding: Accurately reflects Bareni's policies on human-in-the-loop controls for money movement and code handover without asserting unverified claims.
